facts.summary: Core interface transform(payload) returns JSON without modifying input; load_payload reads UTF8 JSON; build_component writes result to UTF8 JSON.
Input includes session_key_hex (32-byte AES), base_nonce_hex, file_hex, chunk_size, max_retries, optional thumbnail_hex, corrupt_attempts, environment.

Output structure: blocks (kind/index/nonce_hex/ciphertext_hex/plaintext_sha256), attempts (block/attempt/verified), notifications (block/error), failed_block, file_sha256.
